top news.title: The EU issues two decisions under the DMA that order Google to provide rival AI assistants and search engines comparable access to Android and some Search data

tweets.author: @hennavirkkunen
tweets.text: Today, we issued 2 sets of binding specification measures to Google under the DMA. With these measures, we aim to support innovation & diversity in the EU by enabling fair competition in the markets for AI assistants on Android devices & search engines.  [image]

tweets.author: @glenngabe
tweets.text: Grab the popcorn.  This will be interesting :) I see Google using cybersecurity risks as a reason to not share.  We'll see

top news.title: Uber agrees to acquire Delivery Hero in a deal that values the German food delivery company at ~$14.8B, offering €41.50 per share and buying Prosus' 16.8% stake

tweets.author: @niklasoestberg
tweets.text: After 15 years of incredibly hard work, we're partnering with Uber in a transaction valuing Delivery Hero at €13bn! 🚀 Very proud of what the team has built, and excited for the future. [image]

tweets.author: @capexandchill
tweets.text: Dara confirmed Uber will continue to invest in organic growth, autonomous tech, and stock buybacks.  Some interesting aspects to Delivery Hero is their advertising business is highly developed, representing roughly 3% of its GMV, which is a higher penetration rate than Uber's current advertising business.  Uber plans to utilize Delivery Hero's advertising team and technology to optimize and expand its own high-margin ad tech division.  [video]

tweets.author: @_balaji_km
tweets.text: Our offer to acquire Delivery Hero exceeds the very high bar we set for M&A: a business that's ~10% of Uber's market cap, but adds ~20% to our trips and Gross Bookings and drives significant accretion post close.  For Delivery, the transaction is transformational, roughly doubling our trip volumes and increasing GBs by nearly 50%.

top news.title: TSMC reports Q2 revenue up 36% YoY to ~$39.45B, net income up 77.4% YoY to ~$21.9B, both above est., and says chips 7nm or smaller were 77% of its wafer revenue

TSMC raises its 2026 capex projection from $52B-$56B to $60B-$64B and its revenue growth projection in USD from 30%+ to 40%+ YoY, citing “the AI megatrend”

top news.title: Netflix reports Q2 revenue up 13% YoY to $12.56B, vs. $12.59B est., and says it will give fewer engagement updates starting in 2027; NFLX drops 7%+ after hours

sub_items.title: Netflix says roughly 300 titles used generative AI this year, mostly in post-production, “to deliver higher quality output more quickly and at a lower cost”
